A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Covariance Density Neural Networks and contain readable main text, Appendices A.1–A.9, 17 figures and five tables. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v2 reports original financial forecasting and EEG classification results in Tables 1–2, plus original synthetic experiments, ablations and stability analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original financial forecasting and EEG classification results in Tables 1–2 and the original experimental analyses throughout the appendices.

M1.justification: Definitions 5–7 retain the same covariance-density operator, polynomial filters and multiscale network. The learnable-beta variant and reconstruction procedure are also unchanged; the revised appendix proof does not alter an algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Exchange Rate, S&P 500 and US Stock forecasting; BCI-2A two-class and four-class and PhysioNet motor imagery; and the same synthetic entropy, reconstruction and regression scenarios.

E2.justification: Financial Table 1 retains VNN, GCN, GIN, GAT and Hybrid alongside CDNN. EEG Table 2 retains VNN, GIN, GAT, EEGNet and CSP+LDA alongside CDNN. Comparator membership in the appendix analyses also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The financial 60/20/20 split and forecasting horizons, EEG subject-based evaluation protocols, preprocessing, metrics and training configurations in Tables 3–4 are unchanged. No new evaluation procedure is introduced.

E4.justification: The appendices retain the same learnable-beta evaluation, beta ablations, scalability analysis, eigenbasis comparison, entropy examples, covariance reconstruction and perturbation/regression stability tests. Their questions and supporting evidence are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains mean and standard deviation over three seeds; Table 2 retains variability across subjects/folds. Appendix A.5 retains runtime variability across seeds, with no revised run-count disclosures or uncertainty procedures.

E6.justification: Main-text and appendix numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. Examples include CDNN's BCI-2A accuracies of 73.4% and 50.4% in Table 2 and the entropy-based AUC of 0.9869 in Appendix A.8.

T1.justification: Appendix A.9 corrects Theorem 9's proof. v2 incorrectly asserts infinite derivative limits with reversed signs; v3 derives finite negative and positive limits using the extreme eigenvalues. This repairs the existence argument for the same unique beta optimum without changing the objective or theorem.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: covariance-density filtering, control of stability versus discriminability, covariance entropy, and improved financial and subject-independent EEG performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of beta, noise robustness and cross-subject transfer remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning second-order statistics, nonstationarity and computational cost; appendix qualifications about entropy applicability and imperfect matrix reconstruction also remain.

D1.justification: Hardware, architectures, hyperparameters, preprocessing, caching and data-access information are unchanged. Resolving the Adam citation does not change the optimizer already documented in v2.

R1.justification: v3 adds the Kingma and Ba (2015) bibliography entry and resolves the Adam '(72)' citation in appendix footnote 4. Other reference edits update metadata for existing works; the substantive research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized edits expand GMRF, identify E as the density error matrix in Lemma 1, adjust punctuation and terminology, and update bibliographic and publication information. Most prose and the section and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds a publication running header and first-page review information, with localized text reflow and spacing adjustments. All 17 figures and five tables retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: Replacing v2's incorrect infinite derivative limits with justified finite limits in Theorem 9 repairs the existence proof for the nondegenerate setting in Appendix A.9. Together with small notation and citation repairs, this improves rigor and clarity. The overall gain is limited because the method, empirical evidence and central claims remain unchanged.
